description: This file implements factory classes for creating SRS estimators, including generic and pooled versions, and functions to instantiate these factories. It also defines methods for creating estimators and validators, and references multiple external classes and functions related to signal processing in a 3GPP context.

classes.name: srs_estimator_factory_generic
classes.description: Factory class for creating generic SRS estimators with specific dependencies.

classes.name: srs_estimator_factory_pool
classes.description: Factory class for creating pooled SRS estimators to support concurrency.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new SRS estimator instance, decorated with logging.

methods.name: create_validator
methods.description: Creates a validator for SRS estimator configuration.
